decisions.reason: The citrus crate was presented as a flagship and serves a seasonal agricultural niche where reusable crates sell over many years, so its absence from the website in 2020–2021 weakens but does not yet resolve its value, and keeping it costs little.
Foldable large containers are core to returnable packaging and cost little to hold in the range, so missing website visibility alone does not justify giving up the option.
Stackable crates use existing tooling and are cheap to keep, but having only been mentioned and then not observed is a growing sign that this line may be folded into the standard range.
The rackable pallet serves established pallet customers at low marginal cost, though its fading website presence raises the chance it gets consolidated with other pallet lines.
The spill-retention pallet meets a durable regulatory need in industrial handling, so keeping this low-cost niche option open remains sensible despite limited visibility.
The pallet with load retainers is a specialized variant with low holding cost, and missing visibility suggests weak uptake but not yet enough evidence to abandon it.
